docs.title: Board API
docs.intro: A small HTTP API over the board. Every call is checked against the token's permissions and shows up on the board in real time.
docs.authText: Create a token in Board API settings and send it as a bearer token.
docs.rolesNote: A custom token can combine any permissions; every custom token can also read tasks.
docs.handoffText: Paste this into any script or assistant tool that can make HTTP requests, together with a token.
